summary.headline: Bardesanes’ Six-Thousand-Year World
summary.text: Bardesanes’ computation of planetary circuits and synods culminating in a six-thousand-year duration for the world, attributed to ancient Chaldean numerology and compared with Aetius, Pseudo-Aristotle’s On the Cosmos, and Apuleius’ On the World. The page ends with manuscript and textual corrections, including readings for Moroes and Mizeaoul.
